name: Neon Grid 3D
description: Low-poly 3D in a dark-navy grid world: a glowing grid floor that fades into fog, dark pillars and a glowing-brick wall, blocky characters and objects lit by one cool key light with a single soft shadow. The camera glides slowly through the set. Gaming, tech and internet-culture explainers. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 6-10 scenes (3-5 s). Each: title.kicker + title.main, visual.type "scene3d" with 1-3 objects: character (anim idle/walk/yes/no), monitor, phone, server, chip, lock, gear, cube. Short labels. No emoji.
